test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight relatives, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W and Y are sitting around a square table in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the square while four sit in the middle of each of four sides, all of them facing the centre of the square.

P sits third to the left of V. R is not an immediate neighbour of V. Only one person sits between V and W. S sits second to the right of Q. R is not an immediate neighbour of P. T sits second left of P.

Who sits fourth to the right of P?
solution:
Given that: P, Q, R, S, T, V, W and Y are sitting around a square table in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the square while four sit in the middle of each of four sides, all of them facing the centre of the square.

Explanation:

 

 
• P sits third to the left of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9baecfc7159645dc5cbde1c52d442d5f5b2d4394e52091e2aa56e97b9437dc2e.png] 

 
• T sits second left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc492960866511dd04229b9cbbbec5e276118660fc810d91ab52b609d4fe6a54.png] 

 
• R is not an immediate neighbour of V
 
• R is not an immediate neighbour of P. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70a4aa2447e17c17804c2bc5bb5b526784a01814da5225769f52cf1b09b345a9.png] 

 
• Only one person sits between V and W
 
• S sits second to the right of Q.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c7cfb9716d1d56f75d8d7450437e20e7ac82deccce9e9589ea3899ac8863ed5.png] 

**S** sits fourth to the right of P

Hence, **"Option 3" **is the **correct answer.**
